maddeler.e:
أستسئل (form X)
# أَسْتَسْئِلُ (ʔastasʔilu) /ʔas.tas.ʔi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# أَسْتَسْئِلَ (ʔastasʔila) /ʔas.tas.ʔi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# أَسْتَسْئِلْ (ʔastasʔil) /ʔas.tas.ʔil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
